reason: With 10 staff we exceed the 5-user Starter plan, and jumping straight to the Pro Tier at ₹4,999 a month billed annually forces an upfront commitment of nearly ₹60,000. That is far too steep for my frugal practice to risk without testing team adoption first.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: A mid-sized firm plan priced under ₹25,000 a year for up to 15 staff, or a monthly billing option for Pro, plus third-party verification of the drive.file restricted scope.
